summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing a renewed tranche of its ongoing share buyback programme. The company entered an agreement with Goldman Sachs International to repurchase ordinary shares from July 30, 2026, until October 12, 2026. The programme's purpose is to reduce share capital, with shares repurchased to be cancelled. Purchases are made within pre-set parameters and under shareholder authority from the 2026 AGM permitting up to 217,492,219 shares. The maximum price is capped at 105% of average market value over five business days or the higher of last independent trade/bid. This represents a continuation of capital returns to shareholders.
